thread:
Maya (Product): Heads-up: design review for the Usage & Billing dashboard. Primary goals: clarify spend trends, show token breakdown per model, and make invoices + CSV exports obvious for finance. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/def

Ethan (Design): Two patterns: Compact Overview (single page with collapsible sections) vs. Nav Tabs (Overview / Projects / Invoices). Tabs make exports discoverable; compact helps quick scanning. Drafts updated.

Rita (Eng): Note on data: we have daily rollups and a streaming buffer for last 7 days. Per-model per-project breakdown beyond 30d will be served from nightly rollups. We can show a "data freshness" badge when using cached data.

Sam (Finance): Must-haves: CSV export with tokens_prompt, tokens_completion, tokens_total, unit_price, tax, proration dates. PDFs should include billing address and VAT. Exports should be easy to find without extra clicks.

Ari (DevEx): Copy suggestions: use "Viewing: Organization — <name>" and for token legend: "Billed tokens = prompt + completion". Export CTA: "Download invoice (CSV)" with keyboard focus.

Ethan (Design): Accessibility: avoid color-only legends; add pattern fills and explicit text labels. For dense matrices, provide a table fallback that screen readers can parse.

Maya (Product): Decisions: tabs (Overview/Projects/Invoices); Overview defaults to 30d with quick toggles for 7/30/90; show top 5 models by spend + expandable project matrix; Billing tab lists invoices with download actions.

Rita (Eng): API plan: `/billing/summary?range=30d`, `/billing/models?range=7d&limit=5`, `/billing/invoices?format=csv&start=&end=` with RBAC checks. We'll add signed URLs for downloads and audit logs.

billing-bot: Alert: high latency on `/billing/invoices` observed 2025-03-02T14:20Z, p95=2.9s.

Sam (Finance): Also request a sample CSV fixture and a one-page mapping of invoice fields to UI labels. I'll share legal wording for PDFs.

Ethan (Design): I'll update mocks to include patterns, staleness badge, and the invoice CTA in header. Posting new frames in 18h.

Rita (Eng): Rough ETA: Overview + staleness badge = 1 sprint. Projects matrix + lazy export job = 1 sprint. Invoices + signed URLs = 1 sprint, auth permitting.

Maya (Product): Thanks. I'll open tickets and link the Figma. Quick poll: Tabs = :one:, Compact = :two:.

Ethan (Design): :one:
Rita (Eng): :one:
Sam (Finance): :one:
Ari (DevEx): :one:

Maya (Product): Tabs it is. Closing thread — ping here for follow-ups.
